sections.title: Your first event, step by step.
sections.lead: Seven steps and a person on WhatsApp if you get stuck. Here’s everything between downloading {{brand.stores.hostAppName}} and the morning after your first event.

actions.label: Set it up with us on WhatsApp

to.message: Hi {{brand.name}}, I’d like help setting up my first event.

aside.label: Moving an existing group from WhatsApp? Read the switching guide

items.label: Download {{brand.stores.hostAppName}}
items.body: {{brand.stores.hostAppName}} is the app you run everything from, on iPhone, Android or iPad.
tips: Sign in with your phone number
Add co-hosts and managers to your team later

items.label: Make your page
items.body: Your page is where people find you, follow you and book. Give it your name, a photo and a line about what you do.
tips: Use the photo people already know you by
Already listed on {{brand.name}}? Claim your page instead

items.label: Create your first event
items.body: Pick the format closest to your night, then add the date, place, price and capacity.
tips: Set a cancellation policy now, not after the first request
Turn on applications if you want to approve each guest
When the event is full, new bookings join the waitlist

items.label: Connect payments
items.body: Connect a Razorpay account so guests can pay by UPI or card, and the money is paid into your own account. Razorpay’s KYC check usually takes 1 to 2 working days, so do this early.
tips: Free events don’t need payments set up
Payment gateway fees are separate from {{brand.name}}’s 5%

items.label: Share your link
items.body: Put the event’s link in your bio and in each WhatsApp group you already run.
tips: Ask the friends who’ll bring people to share it too

items.label: Run the door
items.body: Open the door in {{brand.stores.hostAppName}}. Guests scan in on their own phones; you see who’s in, who’s late and who’s new.
tips: Decide how many walk-ins you’ll take
Give a helper door access for the event, on their own phone

items.label: Follow up
items.body: Send a thank-you, ask for a review and put the next event up while people still want it.
tips: Reviews from people who booked show on your page
People who came can follow you for the next one

steps.title: Tickets on sale
steps.body: Open bookings early so people can plan, and share the link with the friends who’ll bring others.

steps.title: Share it everywhere you already are
steps.body: Your bio, each WhatsApp group, and each friend who promised to bring people.

steps.title: Check your door list
steps.body: See who’s booked and how many walk-ins you can take, and message everyone where to be and what to bring from the app.

steps.title: Open the door on your phone
steps.body: Guests scan in. You see who’s in, who’s late and who’s new, then put the phone away and host.

steps.title: Thank them and set the next event
steps.body: Send a thank-you and ask for a review. People who came can follow you for the next one.

to.message: Hi {{brand.name}}, I’d like help setting up my first event.

sections.title: Pick the night closest to yours.
sections.lead: Each format comes with its own live tools. Running something else? Pick an open format and choose the tools you want.

items.title: Run or walk
items.body: Pace groups and a first hello at the start line.

items.title: Quiz or game night
items.body: Teams at the door, scores on the screen.

items.title: Crawl
items.body: A route between venues, with groups that move together.

items.title: Open format
items.body: Check-in, groups, prompts and announcements for any kind of night.

actions.label: See the room, format by format

items.title: Opening too late
items.body: A few days isn’t much time for people to plan. Give it two weeks.

items.title: No cancellation policy
items.body: Set one before the first request, so every booking has the same terms.

items.title: No plan for walk-ins
items.body: Decide how many you’ll take before the night, not at the door.

items.title: No next event
items.body: The morning after is when people want to book again. Have one ready.

items.question: How long until I can sell tickets?
items.answer: Free events can go live as soon as you publish. Paid tickets go on sale once Razorpay’s KYC check is done, which usually takes 1 to 2 working days.

items.question: What does it cost?
items.answer: Nothing for 30 days from your first event, or 90 for founding hosts. Then 5% of ticket sales, never more than ₹10,000 a month. Free events stay free.

items.question: Do my guests need the app?
items.answer: No. Guests book, pay and check in on your page in their phone’s browser.

items.question: Can I do it from a laptop?
items.answer: You set up in {{brand.stores.hostAppName}} on your phone or iPad. On a laptop, the start page has a code to scan with your phone.

items.question: What if I’m not sure which format fits?
items.answer: Message us on WhatsApp and tell us about your night. We’ll suggest one and help you set it up.
